Description

Welcome to The Hub - Rise Community, a versatile venue located in the heart of Gilden Park, ideal for hosting a wide range of events and activities. Whether you're planning a fitness class, community gathering, workshop, or celebration, this adaptable space is designed to meet your needs.

Hall 1 is the main feature — an expansive room measuring 10.7m x 8.2m. This light-filled space boasts floor-to-ceiling windows that flood the room with natural daylight, while high ceilings add to the open and inviting atmosphere. The hall also includes the convenience of an adjoining kitchen and a separate entrance, offering added flexibility and privacy for your events.

With modern facilities, a welcoming setting, and a location easily accessible from across the area, The Hub - Rise Community is the perfect venue to bring your community together.
